en.title: Ted Lasso Season 4 Arrives August 2026: Your Weekly Episode Drop Schedule
en.summary: The wait for AFC Richmond's return is almost over. Apple TV+ has officially unveiled the release schedule for Ted Lasso Season 4, confirming when fans can expect new episodes.
en.body:
Get your biscuits ready, folks! After what feels like an eternity, **Ted Lasso** is finally returning to the pitch. Apple TV+ has pulled back the curtain on the highly anticipated fourth season, and for fans eager to know exactly when they can dive back into the heartwarming world of AFC Richmond, the release schedule is here.

Season 4 is set to premiere on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, with the first episode dropping that day. Following the premiere, new episodes will be released every Wednesday through October 7, 2026. This familiar weekly drop format allows fans to savor each installment, discuss theories, and eagerly anticipate the next chapter, much like they did with previous seasons. While the exact details of the "wrinkle" mentioned in earlier teasers that allows some fans to watch earlier than the listed dates remain a bit of a mystery, the core release structure ensures a consistent flow of content for the show's dedicated global audience.

## The Road to Season 4

The journey to this fourth season has been one of anticipation and speculation. With **Jason Sudeikis** returning as the relentlessly optimistic American football coach navigating the complexities of English football and life, the series has cemented its place as a feel-good phenomenon. Season 3 left many storylines in compelling places, and fans have been clamoring for resolution and new adventures. The announcement of the release date and schedule offers concrete proof that the team behind **Ted Lasso** is gearing up to deliver more of the signature wit, emotional depth, and character-driven narratives that have earned the show numerous accolades, including multiple Emmy Awards. The series continues to be a flagship title for Apple TV+, showcasing its commitment to premium, character-focused storytelling that resonates deeply with viewers.

## What This Means for the Faithful

For the passionate fanbase that has grown with **Ted Lasso**, this schedule confirmation is more than just dates on a calendar; it's a promise of shared experiences. The weekly release format is a gift to binge-watchers and casual viewers alike, fostering a communal viewing experience. It allows for sustained conversation across social media, fan forums, and water cooler chats, keeping the spirit of AFC Richmond alive week after week. The stakes for the characters, and by extension the narrative, feel higher than ever, and knowing exactly when to tune in allows fans to prepare themselves for the emotional rollercoaster that **Ted Lasso** consistently provides. It means recommitting to the characters, their triumphs, and their inevitable setbacks, all while enjoying the unique blend of humor and heart that defines the show.

## What's Next

With the premiere set for August 5, 2026, and a 10-episode run planned, fans can mark their calendars. Keep an eye out for further details regarding the specific plot points and character arcs that will unfold in this highly anticipated season.

content_raw: Ted Lasso Season 4 has a weekly release schedule on Apple TV, with one wrinkle that lets fans watch new episodes earlier than the listed dates.
